name: National Weather Service
description: United States federal agency responsible for weather forecasts, warnings and observations.

name: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
description: United States scientific agency for oceanic and atmospheric conditions; parent of the National Weather Service.

name: World Meteorological Organization
description: Specialised agency of the United Nations for meteorology, operational hydrology and geophysical sciences.

name: Deutscher Wetterdienst
description: German national meteorological service, responsible for forecasts and warnings in Germany.
notes: Provisional until a primary source is cited. Recorded as an identity anchor, not as a supported assertion.

name: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts
description: Intergovernmental organisation producing global numerical weather predictions.
notes: Provisional until a primary source is cited.

name: Beaufort wind force scale
description: Empirical scale relating wind speed to observed conditions at sea and on land, numbered from 0 to 12.

name: Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale
description: Classification of hurricanes into five categories by sustained wind speed.

name: Enhanced Fujita Scale
description: Classification of tornado intensity from EF0 to EF5, estimated from observed damage.
